g.text: Reservation System — Application contracts and infrastructure
Dashed triangle = structural implementation; explicit inheritance is not required.
Service fields show all injected contracts; package arrows group their dependencies.
Adapter method lists repeat the port contract and are omitted.
Method parameters and helper methods are omitted; return types are retained.
All SQL repositories and SqlUnitOfWork share one request-scoped Session.
Domain classes are detailed in domain-classes.puml.
FastAPI controllers are functions, so they are not represented as classes.
